mentions.name: Open-Window Weather Notifier
mentions.description: This website notifies users when it's time to open or close their windows. Users register with a location, a preferred notification method (email, text, or web push), and rules defining their ideal open-windows weather, such as a temperature range plus optional humidity and wind speed thresholds. No local sensors, motors, or smart home devices are required; it works purely from weather data, with the human physically opening and closing the windows. Adding air quality data from nearby sensors is a future possibility.
